courses.name: Trysil
courses.description: Spennende og variert 18 hulls skogsbane, par 72, som ligger fint i terrenget. Mange utfordrende hull både for nybegynnerne og erfarne golfspillere. Handikapkrav, minimum gjennomført VTG-kurs.

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: Et blindt åpningshull med to adskilte fairwayer. Den beste måten å skape seg et godt utgangspunkt på, er å sikte mot den store furua på øverste platå. Stor høydeforskjell gjør at du trenger mindre kølle på innspillet. Greenen voktes av to bunkere.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: Banens enkleste hull, men pass deg for bunkeren på venstre side foran green.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: Et kort par 4 hull med vann til venstre. Lønner seg å spille kort av vannet, men ofte må du bruke en ekstra kølle på innspillet på grunn av høydeforskjellen. Se opp for bunkeren til høyre for green.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: Et kort par 5 hull der de langtslående kan nå inn på to slag. Vær oppmerksom på bekken som krysser fairway. Green er beskyttet med en bunker kort foran og en i venstre forkant. Unngå å slå over greenen.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: Et kort par 4 hull, men her lønner det seg å la driveren ligge i bagen. Noe høydeforskjell opp til green, gjør at du kan velge en ekstra kølle.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description:
Dogleg venstre med bunker i landingssonen. Høydeforskjellen fra tee til green, gjør at
du må bruke ekstra med kølle hele veien.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: Et nytt kort par 5 hull som kan nås på to slag. For å se green ved innspillet, må du ligge på høyre side. Bunker kort til høyre for banens største green. Legg derfor merke til fargen på  flagget før du velger kølle for innspill.

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: Et flott par 3 hull med vann som egentlig ikke er i spill. Green voktes av en dyp bunker foran, så venstre side av green er et godt siktepunkt.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: Med en god drive her, er grunnlaget lagt for en god score. Noe høydeforskjell på innspillet til green, gjør at det kan lønne seg med en ekstra kølle. Pass opp for dyp bunker i forkant av green.

holes.name: Hål 10
holes.description: Et åpent hull der du bør legge utslaget på høyre side av fairway. Store furuer i landingssonen kan komme i spill. Vær oppmerksom på kryssende bekk foran green. Hold innspillet til høyre på dette hullet.

holes.name: Hål 11
holes.description: Et tøft par 4 hull med høydeforskjell fra tee til green. Vann krysser fairway 130 m fra senter green. Se opp for blind bunker på venstre side av green.

holes.name: Hål 12
holes.description: Et par 5 hull med bred landingssone. Her kan driveren gi deg et godt utgangspunkt. Vann krysser i forkant av green og det er en dyp bunker på høyre side. Innspillet kan med fordel legges på venstre side av  flagget for å få en oppover putt.

holes.name: Hål 13
holes.description: Et par 3 hull der green er beskyttet av tre bunkere. Velg mindre kølle på grunn av høydeforskjellen.

holes.name: Hål 14
holes.description: Et tøft par 4 hull med smalt landingsfelt og bunker på venstre side. Hold innspillet på venstre side av green, da det ligger to bunkere på høyre side..

holes.name: Hål 15
holes.description: Et hull hvor de langtslående kan nå green på et slag. Vær oppmerksom på strategisk plasserte bunkere både i fairway og ved green.

holes.name: Hål 16
holes.description: Et monster av et par 5 hull. Her må de fleste ha tre gode slag for å nå inn til en liten green som voktes av både en bunker og en bekk i forkant og til høyre for green. Lykke til!

holes.name: Hål 17
holes.description: Et par 3 hull med stor green. Vær imidlertid oppmerksom på tre bunkere på høyre side. Ta nok kølle på grunn av høydeforskjellen.

holes.name: Hål 18
holes.description: Avslutningshullet er en utfordring for de fleste. Fairway heller mot høyre, så hold utslaget på venstre side. Innspill til venstre side av green, gjør at du setter bunkere på høyre side ut av spill.

courseArray.name: Trysil
courseArray.description: Spennende og variert 18 hulls skogsbane, par 72, som ligger fint i terrenget. Mange utfordrende hull både for nybegynnerne og erfarne golfspillere. Handikapkrav, minimum gjennomført VTG-kurs.

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: Et blindt åpningshull med to adskilte fairwayer. Den beste måten å skape seg et godt utgangspunkt på, er å sikte mot den store furua på øverste platå. Stor høydeforskjell gjør at du trenger mindre kølle på innspillet. Greenen voktes av to bunkere.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: Banens enkleste hull, men pass deg for bunkeren på venstre side foran green.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: Et kort par 4 hull med vann til venstre. Lønner seg å spille kort av vannet, men ofte må du bruke en ekstra kølle på innspillet på grunn av høydeforskjellen. Se opp for bunkeren til høyre for green.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: Et kort par 5 hull der de langtslående kan nå inn på to slag. Vær oppmerksom på bekken som krysser fairway. Green er beskyttet med en bunker kort foran og en i venstre forkant. Unngå å slå over greenen.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: Et kort par 4 hull, men her lønner det seg å la driveren ligge i bagen. Noe høydeforskjell opp til green, gjør at du kan velge en ekstra kølle.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description:
Dogleg venstre med bunker i landingssonen. Høydeforskjellen fra tee til green, gjør at
du må bruke ekstra med kølle hele veien.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: Et nytt kort par 5 hull som kan nås på to slag. For å se green ved innspillet, må du ligge på høyre side. Bunker kort til høyre for banens største green. Legg derfor merke til fargen på  flagget før du velger kølle for innspill.

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: The Starting Hole is a slight dogleg to the right. The fairway is framed by avocado trees and the green is slightly elevated and protected by bunkers. Opening Tee shot to the middle of the fairway, second shot laid up short of the green.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: Appears quite easy but this challenging Par 3 demands a lot of respect.Hit the middle of the green and forget about the position of the flag.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: From an elevated tee and a fairway that slopes from right to left, hit a good drive left off centre. The approach shot must be very precise due to the position and characteristics of the green.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: Excellent use of the natural features have been made on this very challenging Par 5 hole. Difficult decision: keep left to avoid the bunkers, aim second shot towards the right and hit third shot into the putting surface. Beware of the arroyo (stream) in front of the green. This hole is a true test for a championship golfer.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: A good tee shot is essential for this tough 5th Hole, so aim for the middle of the fairway and don’t carry the bunker!. The three-tiered undulating green makes club selection crucial and will test the putting ability of anyplayer.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description: Dogleg left. Brave players who choose to fly over the cork tree on the left can set up an easy second shot, so here is a chance to make a birdie! However, on reaching the green, study the contours carefully.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: Par 3 Hole guarded on the right by the river Ojen. The Arroyo (stream) Campillos in front of the green provides a real challenge. Judgement of the wind is vital!!..

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: The longest hole favouring the longer hitter. Play always to the left of the fairway which leaves you with a wide approach to the green.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: Gentle uphill Par 4. The green can easily be reached in two, provided the tee shot finds the middle of the fairway.

holes.name: Hål 10
holes.description: The second nine opens with a Par 5 with a generously wide fairway and overwhelming scenic beauty. Play right of the bunker, followed by a long iron short of the lake. The receptive long green is defended by bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 11
holes.description: Dogleg to the right. Tee shot must avoid the bunkers. Demanding second shot requires accuracy towards an elevated triangular shaped green well flanked by bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 12
holes.description: Challenging Par 3, playing downhill towards a very large and undulating green, with bunkers on the left and a severe drop into eucalyptus trees behind the green.

holes.name: Hål 13
holes.description: Uphill tee shot. Make sure you take an extra club on the second shot. The sloping green is well bunkered left and right and difficult to putt.

holes.name: Hål 14
holes.description: Straight Par 4 with a narrow approach to the green guarded by bunkers.No problem off the tee but be wary of a difficult undulating green.

holes.name: Hål 15
holes.description: Slightly uphill tee shot with bunkers on the right not visible from the tee. Play second shot to the centre of the fairway avoiding a sea of bunkers. The approach to the green must avoid the lake on the right hand side.

holes.name: Hål 16
holes.description: A very testing Par 3 with bunkers and water protecting the green. Much care is essential on the putting surface due to the many undulations.

holes.name: Hål 17
holes.description: Short Par 4 dogleg right, second shot nothing more than a wedge for the approach, leaving you with a birdie chance.

holes.name: Hål 18
holes.description: A very demanding Finishing Hole, with a lake along the right hand side and avocado trees on the left that make for a narrow entrance. The second shot requires extreme accuracy to get the ball to a tricky elevated green.

club.description_html:
Welcome to Santana Golf, situated at the heart of the “Mijas Golf Valley”, halfway between Fuengirola, Marbella and La Cala, and only 20 kilometers from the Málaga international airport.

Our course is an 18 Hole golf course par 72 of approx. 6207 metres in length, set in 138 acres of picturesque parkland. Santana Golf, sympathetically laid out by the architect Cabell B. Robinson, is set in a former avocado plantation which provided a natural solution to many problems. The final result is a magnificent course with wide and well-defined fairways on level terrain, hence easily walkable, where water features play an important albeit not excessive part in the overall design.

In spite of its previous use, the Avocado Tree is not the only tree present here, as many other endemic species like eucalyptus, orange and lemon trees among others, make up the varied vegetation of this beautiful enclave. The cork oaks along the 5th hole deserve special mention, as they have been present here for more than 500 years.

The beautiful environment with its natural surrounding will give the golfer the overriding impression of an existing maturity in every aspect of the course. Surrounded by the rivers Ojén and Las Pasadas, and very close to the Mediterranean Sea, our course is set in the Sierra de Mijas Natural Park with breathtaking views of the mountains; perhaps this is the reason why it’s also known as “The Seven Hills Course”.

Santana Golf is technically speaking a demanding course as the unique design of each hole is intended to give a continuous challenge, even for the more experienced player. One of the most outstanding features of Santana Golf is without a doubt the variety in design, as each and every hole is differentiated by its own characteristics. The combination of magnificent design, excellent state of preservation and client attention, together with a competitive pricing strategy, have made Santana Golf a landmark in Andalucía.

To sum it all up, we are dealing here with a magnificent and spectacular course, where all these combined elements, together with the superb climate of the area and the expertise of the staff, turn Santana Golf into a course beyond your dreams, golfers’ paradise, “an area of outstanding beauty where golf and nature are one”.

Welcome to the Course All Golfers Want to Play.

club.name: Las Brisas

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: A good drive on this short downhill par 4 is played on a line down the right side of the fairway, just left of the new fairway bunker. The approach shot must be played precisely over the existing lake to a green that has been enlarged back left closer to the water and is guarded by bunkers short left and behind.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: This dogleg right par 4 plays downhill to a generous landing area that is guarded by an existing creek on the right which is defined by a new bunker.  A new back tee has been added and two bunkers on the left have been relocated to show the preferred line and to come into play for long drives.  From the fairway, the uphill approach plays to a new green complex that has been lowered to sit more naturally into the land and to better receive longer approach shots.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: From the existing tee positions, the visibility of the bunkers at the top of the hill has been improved.  From the landing area, members will notice that the green has been pulled forward and further away from the 8th fairway, allowing this former extremely short par 5 to now play as a long par 4. Even though approach shots play shorter downhill than the distance would indicate, players need to carefully consider the sloping lie and sea breezes to avoid the existing lake on the left side of the new green.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: The tees of this long, uphill par 3 have been relocated higher up the slope to provide a better angle to the green and to create separation from the 8th fairway. The green complex has been restored closely to the original Robert Trent Jones Sr. design.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: This, the longest par 5 on the course has been lengthened further with the addition of a new back tee. The two right side bunkers have been moved to the inside of the driving zone on this downhill dogleg right.  The bunkers on the left between the 1st and 2nd turnpoints have been extended up the hill and are now visible from the second shot. This hole maintains the essence of the original design, including the blind approach to the green from the driving zone.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description: The back tee on this strategic par 4 has been extended slightly and the fairway has been reduced on the right.  A new bunker was added in line with the existing creek for better definition of the creek crossing from the tee.  The original lake has been lowered to provide a better view of the water.  The green complex has been restored to the RTJ, Sr. design.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: The green complex has been lowered in order to naturalize the natural amphitheatre effect around the back and right of the green.  Lowering the green has also allowed it to move left and closer to the existing lake. The sensation of the original deep-faced bunker design on the left remains, but is now more connected to the water’s edge.

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: The tees have been lengthened and the new back tee is now located at a lower elevation on the left edge of the lake.  A short aiming bunker has been added for this back tee shot and a saving bunker has been added along the slope on the right, just above the existing creek.  The green has been moved forward and is now much closer to the creek, making for a challenging approach to this par 5.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: The tees have been extended back and the green complex brought forward allowing the length of this short par 4 to be maintained and the green to no longer be constrained by the clubhouse. The fairway has also been re-bunkered. This drivable par 4 green can be reached by carrying the new fairway bunker on the left and running up through the fairway approach which is guarded by greenside bunkers left and right.

holes.name: Hål 10
holes.description: Just a short short walk from the new halfway house, the new upper back tee has slightly lengthened the drive to the landing area. The former two bunkers on the right have been redesigned to guard the inside of this dogleg left par 4 for the lower handicap player, while allowing more room for the higher handicap player on the right.  Also a new front tee has been positioned to the right side of the existing tee line, just left of the existing path.   The green and surrounding bunkers have been pulled slightly forward to allow for softer slopes surrounding the new green.  Selective tree removal and thinning has restored the view of the sea.

holes.name: Hål 11
holes.description: The 11th hole remains in its former position, with its beautiful aspect looking downhill towards the sea and over the existing lake.  The green has been pulled slightly forward and repositioned closer the lake edge with a long bunker guarding the front left side of the green. This loss of length at the green has been offset by the addition of a new back tee.  The green side bunkers have been expanded and deepened behind the green to grab balls going long over the green.

holes.name: Hål 12
holes.description: The back and middle tees on this par 5 hole have been shifted to the right of the creek so that all tees are now on the same side, eliminating the need for the previous fence on the left of the tee.  A new target bunker, which comes into play off the tee for the longer hitters, has replaced the two shorter bunkers on the right. Also, two new bunkers define the outside of dogleg at the second turn point.  The lake has been expanded and the green complex repositioned to tempt the long hitters to try to reach this short par 5 in two shots, but with increased risk of inaccurate shots finding the water.

holes.name: Hål 13
holes.description: This dogleg left par 4 has been shifted slightly left and existing olive trees have been replanted down the right side of the hole creating a greater buffer to the surrounding development and road.  New fairway bunkers have been added on the left as well as a bunker long on the right. The new green complex has been pulled forward to give more space to the property boundary.

holes.name: Hål 14
holes.description: This hole has been redesigned and lengthened to play as the longest par 4 on the course. Now a straight away hole through the olive trees, drives that land near the new right side fairway bunker will have the best angle to approach the new green.  Errant approach shots will need to beware of the existing lake which looms near the back left of the green.

holes.name: Hål 15
holes.description: This hole plays slightly uphill to a natural green site beautifully framed by large African trees on the right.  With an existing stream on the left off the tee and an existing lake to cross on the second shot, this strong par 5 now balances the nines and allows the course to once again play to a par 72 for the members.

holes.name: Hål 16
holes.description: With the existing lake of 18 on the right, a cascading waterfall in the foreground and expansive views of the Club House as a backdrop, this new downhill par 3 has been repositioned into one of the most beautiful parts of the entire site.   The combination of these elements provides a majestic and challenging setting for the shortest hole on the course.

holes.name: Hål 17
holes.description: This long and challenging new par 4 plays in the opposite direction of the old 17th hole.  Drives play over the existing lake to a landing area at the top of the hill that is in the same area as the old hole.  Approach shots play downhill over the existing creek to a large well-bunkered green, which is nestled amongst the olive orchards and just right of the old hole 17 tees.

holes.name: Hål 18
holes.description: The back tees have been lengthened and shifted slightly left to be more in line with the middle of the fairway. A new bunker has been added on the left side of the landing area to visually define the edge of the existing pond and grab offline drives from the water. A carry bunker has also been added on the right.  The green has been shifted forward and slightly down the hill, allowing better visibility of the green and a more natural connection of the green and the surrounding bunkers to the existing hillside behind.

club.description_html:
With around 1,225 members comprising of over 30 different nationalities, Real Club de Golf Las Brisas has a warm and vibrant social scene which is supported by superb facilities. Recently renovated to the highest standards, the Clubhouse has all the comforts expected of a modern golf club. The Restaurant and Bar cater for a wide range of tastes, with both indoor and alfresco dining because of a large terrace which overlooks the golf course.


The exceptionally well-stocked Golf Shop is managed by Golf ‘us, who bring their experience from over 60 outlets across Europe. Security is of paramount importance at Real Club de Golf Las Brisas. CCTV is deployed in the ample car parking areas, combined with a card entry system for carparks, locker rooms and also the main gate in the evening.

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: A good drive on this short downhill par 4 is played on a line down the right side of the fairway, just left of the new fairway bunker. The approach shot must be played precisely over the existing lake to a green that has been enlarged back left closer to the water and is guarded by bunkers short left and behind.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: This dogleg right par 4 plays downhill to a generous landing area that is guarded by an existing creek on the right which is defined by a new bunker.  A new back tee has been added and two bunkers on the left have been relocated to show the preferred line and to come into play for long drives.  From the fairway, the uphill approach plays to a new green complex that has been lowered to sit more naturally into the land and to better receive longer approach shots.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: From the existing tee positions, the visibility of the bunkers at the top of the hill has been improved.  From the landing area, members will notice that the green has been pulled forward and further away from the 8th fairway, allowing this former extremely short par 5 to now play as a long par 4. Even though approach shots play shorter downhill than the distance would indicate, players need to carefully consider the sloping lie and sea breezes to avoid the existing lake on the left side of the new green.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: The tees of this long, uphill par 3 have been relocated higher up the slope to provide a better angle to the green and to create separation from the 8th fairway. The green complex has been restored closely to the original Robert Trent Jones Sr. design.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: This, the longest par 5 on the course has been lengthened further with the addition of a new back tee. The two right side bunkers have been moved to the inside of the driving zone on this downhill dogleg right.  The bunkers on the left between the 1st and 2nd turnpoints have been extended up the hill and are now visible from the second shot. This hole maintains the essence of the original design, including the blind approach to the green from the driving zone.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description: The back tee on this strategic par 4 has been extended slightly and the fairway has been reduced on the right.  A new bunker was added in line with the existing creek for better definition of the creek crossing from the tee.  The original lake has been lowered to provide a better view of the water.  The green complex has been restored to the RTJ, Sr. design.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: The green complex has been lowered in order to naturalize the natural amphitheatre effect around the back and right of the green.  Lowering the green has also allowed it to move left and closer to the existing lake. The sensation of the original deep-faced bunker design on the left remains, but is now more connected to the water’s edge.

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: The tees have been lengthened and the new back tee is now located at a lower elevation on the left edge of the lake.  A short aiming bunker has been added for this back tee shot and a saving bunker has been added along the slope on the right, just above the existing creek.  The green has been moved forward and is now much closer to the creek, making for a challenging approach to this par 5.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: The tees have been extended back and the green complex brought forward allowing the length of this short par 4 to be maintained and the green to no longer be constrained by the clubhouse. The fairway has also been re-bunkered. This drivable par 4 green can be reached by carrying the new fairway bunker on the left and running up through the fairway approach which is guarded by greenside bunkers left and right.

holes.name: Hål 10
holes.description: Just a short short walk from the new halfway house, the new upper back tee has slightly lengthened the drive to the landing area. The former two bunkers on the right have been redesigned to guard the inside of this dogleg left par 4 for the lower handicap player, while allowing more room for the higher handicap player on the right.  Also a new front tee has been positioned to the right side of the existing tee line, just left of the existing path.   The green and surrounding bunkers have been pulled slightly forward to allow for softer slopes surrounding the new green.  Selective tree removal and thinning has restored the view of the sea.

holes.name: Hål 11
holes.description: The 11th hole remains in its former position, with its beautiful aspect looking downhill towards the sea and over the existing lake.  The green has been pulled slightly forward and repositioned closer the lake edge with a long bunker guarding the front left side of the green. This loss of length at the green has been offset by the addition of a new back tee.  The green side bunkers have been expanded and deepened behind the green to grab balls going long over the green.

holes.name: Hål 12
holes.description: The back and middle tees on this par 5 hole have been shifted to the right of the creek so that all tees are now on the same side, eliminating the need for the previous fence on the left of the tee.  A new target bunker, which comes into play off the tee for the longer hitters, has replaced the two shorter bunkers on the right. Also, two new bunkers define the outside of dogleg at the second turn point.  The lake has been expanded and the green complex repositioned to tempt the long hitters to try to reach this short par 5 in two shots, but with increased risk of inaccurate shots finding the water.

club.description_html:
The Valle del Este golf course features a beautiful 18-hole layout measuring 5669 meters.

Each hole offers a unique design, creating a fresh chal- lenge with every round.

This variety and thoughtful design allow golfers to truly experience the essence and beauty of Valle del Este with each visit.

The striking contrast between the vibrant green fairways and the golden color of the surrounding semi-desert landscape is truly remarkable.

This exclusive scenery can only be found in Almería, a region with the most sunshine hours in all of continental Europe, where golfers can enjoy the sport in the winter with spring temperatures.

courses.name: 18-hålsbana Värnamo GK
courses.description:
Värnamo Golfklubb ligger vid sjön Hindsen ca. fem minuter från E4:an. Golfbanan är en mycket vacker park och skogsbana och ligger på Näsbyholms gårds tidigare åkermark.  
Välkomna!

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: Ett kort och inbjudande par 5 hål. Men luras inte av rymligheten på hålet. Svårigheterna ligger i precisionen av inspelet mot green.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: Två svårigheter lurar på detta hål. Undvik högersidan på utslaget vilket ger ett svårt inspel runt/över almarna. Greenen lutar kraftigt från höger bakkant. Ta nog klubba på inspelet.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: Se upp för diket som korsar höger sida av fairway i höjd med bunkern. Greenen lutar från spelriktningen.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: Utslaget bör placeras till höger på fairway. Från denna position nås vänster sida av fairway enklast vid ett transportslag. OBS! Ropa FORE vid utslag till vänster mot hål 7!

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: Kort par 3 hål med vinden som största utmaning. Blåser det mot ta alltid extra klubba. Men passa dig för out of bounds bakom green.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description: Kort och trixigt par 4 där utslaget är direkt avgörande om du skall kunna spela mot green på kommande slag. Ju mer till vänster du vågar spela desto lättare inspel.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: Kort par 4 där den långt slående spelaren kan nå green. Bästa linje är till höger på fairway för att undvika sand och vatten till vänster. OBS! Ropa FORE vid utslag till vänster mot hål 4!

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: Ett utslag till vänster sida av fairway rekommenderas. Greenen ligger upphöjd vilket oftast innebär extra klubba vid inspel.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: Vackert korthål där greenen kan ställa till besvär. Bättre lång än kort.

holes.name: Hål 10
holes.description: Utslaget spelas bäst till höger då fairway lutar till vänster. Greenen är svårläst. OBS! Ropa FORE vid utslag till vänster mot hål 18!

holes.name: Hål 11
holes.description: Den försiktige siktar till höger om bunkrarna. Ta alltid extra klubba när vinden blåser emot.

holes.name: Hål 12
holes.description: Kort par 4 som spelas enkel så länge du undviker vänster sida.

holes.name: Hål 13
holes.description: Då hålet spelas uppför är detta en riktig utmaning. Den taktiske spelaren slår sig fram kort om stenmuren för ett längre inspel. Greenen är förhållandevis lättputtad när du nått hela vägen fram.

holes.name: Hål 14
holes.description: Banans svåraste par 3 hål. Kort vänster är att rekommendera på utslaget. Hela höger sidan kan ge dig problem

holes.name: Hål 15
holes.description: För den långt slående måste out gränsen till höger följas. Bunkrar till vänster fångar upp många slag. Väl framme vid inspel står du för nya utmaningar till en upphöjd green. Hellre kort om flaggan än lång. OBS! Ropa FORE vid utslag till vänster.

holes.name: Hål 16
holes.description: Den långt slående håller vänster om fairway bunkern.

holes.name: Hål 17
holes.description: Långt par 4 där diket som korsar fairway styr ditt klubb val. Väl framme vid green, som lutar från spelriktningen, finns bunker till vänster. Terrängen faller ifrån på höger sida. OBS! Ropa FORE vid utslag till vänster mot hål 13.

holes.name: Hål 18
holes.description: Slice är inte att rekommendera på detta utslag. Vilket ger ett långt inspel till en green som lutar kraftigt emot. OBS! Ropa FORE vid utslag till vänster mot hål 13.

courses.name: 9-hålsbana Värnamo GK
courses.description:
9-hål kuperad fullängdsbana
Skogsbana byggd 2005.

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: Kort och inbjudande par 3 där vänster sida samt lång kan ställa till problem.

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: Här bör du spela ditt utslag till vänster. Greenen är lång och smal vilket kan ställa till problem vid klubb val.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: Många utmaningar på vägen fram till green. Utslag kort om bunker ger ett långt inspel. Ta extra klubba vid inspelet mot green.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: För dig som är långt slående kan du gena över vattenhindret till backens början. Minst en extra klubba krävs för att nå platågreenen.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: Ett utslag något till höger och ett andra slag mitt i den breda fairwayen är att rekommendera. Greenen är lättputtad men svårtillgänglig om andra slaget placeras till höger eller vänster.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description: Hur nära vattnet vågar du slå ditt utslag, kommer att avgöra svårigheten i fortsättningen på hålet. Greenen lutar från vänster till höger vilket kan ge dig besvärliga puttar.

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: Spännande par 3 med massor av utmaningar i form av bunkrar. Greenen ligger på tvären vilket gör det svårt med val av klubba.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: Långt par 5 där du skall passera två kanter på vägen mot green. Utslaget bör läggas så nära bunkrarna som du vågar. Andra slaget helst något till höger för att få se greenen vid inspelet. OBS! Försäkra dig om att framförvarande parti är utom räckhåll

club.name: Aulanko Golf
club.description_html:
Aulanko golf comprises two courses and is located at Hämeenlinna which is in the south of Finland. Hämeenlinna is approximately 100 Km north-west of Helsinki. There are excellent motorway and railway connections between Helsinki and Tampere.

The Hugo course dating from 1940 which is attached to the Aulanko Hotel, is a well established mature 9 hole course.

The main course named, Eversti is a 18 hole course recently opened in 2006. The club house is located approximately 2 Km from the Aulanko Hotel.

Tee times must be booked by visitors with the caddie master. Tel. + 358 3 653 7741 toimisto@aulankogolf.fi
www.aulankogolf.fi

club.name: Golf Torrequebrada

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description: The tee shot will have to go above the olive trees to reach the upper part of the fairway, so the ball stays to the right in the valley. Long hitters can take the challenge to reach the green, which is surrounded by bunkers. This is the highest point of the course (102 meters above sea level).

holes.name: Hål 2
holes.description: From the high elevated tee, you look down to the fairway, which is situated by a large bunker on the right side. The green is situated in high and is protected by two large cork trees at its entrance and by bunkers on each side.

holes.name: Hål 3
holes.description: Short par 3 of 89 meters, which requires to be precise. The hole is downhill, the green narrow but elongated with two slopes at front and back, plus being protected by bunkers on the right and behind.

holes.name: Hål 4
holes.description: It requires a good tee shot to reach the fairway. The front of the green slopes and is protected by bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 5
holes.description: High levelled tee with dogleg to the left, which is protected by trees on both sides. This hole allows two ways to play it; drive above the trees on the left or play in to the middle of the fairway. An open green with various bunkers on both sides and behind.

holes.name: Hål 6
holes.description: The straight tee shot from the high-level tee needs to be towards the bunker, in the middle of the fairway.  Dogleg to the right with an uphill approach shot to the elevated green protected by bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 7
holes.description: This is another signature hole with marvelous views over the Mediterranean, playing off a very high elevated tee with an approach shot towards the lake. The approach shot is challenging due to the lake and bunkers on both sides of the green. Please remember, both sides of the fairway are marked as water hazards.

holes.name: Hål 8
holes.description: Dogleg with water hazard on the left and trees on the right, where a good tee shot is required towards the bunker in front. The approach shot is to the high elevated green with two bunkers on both sides for those who stay short and off the green line.

holes.name: Hål 9
holes.description: Par 3 downhill. Bunkers on the right and behind the green. Water hazard with a large and magnificent group of palm trees behind the green.

holes.name: Hål 10
holes.description: From a narrow tee, a precise shot down the fairway is recommended. The longer hitters can play their approach shot above the olive trees on the left. The green is protected by a large bunker behind and to the side. Watch out for the lake on the right.

holes.name: Hål 11
holes.description:
Tee shot above a large lake. Large green with many slopes and 
undulations, protected by bunkers in front, left and behind.

holes.name: Hål 12
holes.description: Fairway with two very steep valleys and narrow tee shot. The big hitters will be able to reach the green in two shots. Be careful with the shot towards the green because of the surrounding bunkers and lake.

holes.name: Hål 13
holes.description: Par 3 of 144 meters with a large and flat green surrounded by bunkers. Be precise!

holes.name: Hål 14
holes.description: A good tee shot is required over the lake with a bunker on the left. Trees on both sides of the fairway up to the green and the two olive trees in the center of the fairway. With a good second shot, the long hitters can reach the green, which is surrounded by bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 15
holes.description: A visual hole protected by pines on both sides of the fairways and bunkers on the left. This dogleg to the right forces to play in the direction of the palm trees to a green that is totally surrounded by bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 16
holes.description: The tee shot needs to be directed to the olive tree in the left center of the fairway. The approach shot is towards a highly elevated and very undulated green with a frontal lake and bunkers.

holes.name: Hål 17
holes.description: A narrow tee shot on an uphill hole with bunkers on the left and trees on the right. The fairway presents a steep valley just in front of the green and bunkers on the left and behind.

holes.name: Hål 18
holes.description: The tee shot is to be played over the olive trees to the fairway with bunkers on the right side. The approach shot is towards a very undulated green surrounded by various bunkers.

club.description_html:
Torrequebrada golf, in Costa del Sol Benalmadena, opened in 1976.
The course was designed by José "Pepe" Gancedo, one of Spain´s most promising amateur golfers.
A beautiful picturesque golf course between the sea and mountains. Come and play.

courses.name: Trosa GK
courses.description: Vindkänslig seasidebana utefter Tureholmsviken och inloppet till Trosa hamn

club.description_html:
Trosa Golfklubb är inte bara en naturskön bana i Sörmlands skärgård – det är en klubb med ambition. Här spelar du golf i en miljö som sticker ut, men också på en bana som utmanar. Banan rör sig genom eklandskapet och öppnar upp mot havet, med utsikt över inloppet till Trosa hamn. 

Vi är stolta över var vi är – men ännu mer fokuserade på vart vi är på väg. Vi satsar aktivt på att modernisera både bana och upplevelse. Det handlar om allt från speldesign och tillgänglighet till hur golfen upplevs – oavsett om du spelar ofta eller är här för första gången. Vi tror på en golf som är inkluderande, utmanande och rolig. Vi har en riktigt bra bana – och vi fortsätter att göra den bättre, varje dag och över tid.

Varmt välkommen att uppleva Trosa GK.

club.description_html: Välkommen till Visby Golfklubb! För oss är det golfsäsong hela året om Att få arbeta med och på en unik bana som Visby GK är fantastiskt. Varje dag strävar jag och mina medarbetare efter att leverera och sätta upp den bästa bana vi kan, utifrån väder, vind och andra omständigheter. Vi som jobbar här älskar spelet golf och platsen Kronholmen. I dialog med Pierre Fulke och Adam Mednicksson vårdar och utvecklar vi banan året om. Vi arbetar mycket med detaljer – ofta för hand med mindre maskiner – inspirerade av den brittiska golfkulturen där man med små medel presenterar fantastiska grönytor. Vi gör helt enkelt vårt yttersta för att få till det där lilla extra, som förhöjer din spel- och naturupplevelse. - Petter Lindblad, Banchef

holes.name: Hål 1
holes.description:
1-Par cuatro fácil donde no sólo debemos preocuparnos del lago frontal. sino también de los límites tanto por la derecha como izquierda. Mejor madera 3, híbrido o hierro largo de salida. Green muy protegido.

Easy starter Par 4, the only real obstacle is the frontal water. 3 wood, hybrid or a long iron will put you in great shape for a second shot to an elevated green protected by a bunker on the left.

club.description_html:
Lauro 27 Golf can be found in the middle of beautiful pure nature in spectacular surroundings. The course consists of 27 holes that can be played in three different combinations, all par 72.

From the beginning the design and function of the course has been based on respecting the nature and the environment that surrounds it by not only saving and caring for the already existing trees but also by planting thousands of new trees, most of them indigenous Andalusian species.

In Lauro Golf the nature is everywhere. Within the whole complex the direct contact with the nature is constant and whether you are playing golf, living in the residences or just enjoying a stroll in the surroundings you can see that we are not the only visitors at Lauro Golf. You can often see rabbits, ducks, partridges, herons and even eagles on and around the golf course, our friendly neighbors who are enjoying the micro-climate of the course created by the thousands of trees and the fourteen lakes of the golf course.

The course was designed by the late Folco Nardi and the idea was to create a course that was technically challenging yet not too difficult. With a good concentration and the correct selection of the clubs the player can end up with a good score in one of the 50 competitions played every year at Lauro Golf.

The extension of the course with the holes 19-27 designed by Mariano Benitez follows the same lines and equally requires concentration and skills. The course is moderately flat and can be played by foot though there are two holes located on the side of the mountain and from which we can enjoy some spectacular views over the valley of Guadalhorce and the Mediterranean.

The club house is located in an old Andalusian building, Cortijo el Paredón, where you can find the restaurant, changing and locker rooms, pro shop and the Caddy Master´s Office. On our premises and the surroundings you can also find a swimming pool, a padel tennis club, lawn bowls club and an equestrian centre. In the middle of the cortijo there is a fabulous patio, with an enormous ficus tree in the middle which offers shade to the players enjoying their food and drinks after a game of golf
